assignments.decisiveDefect: FEE_AND_WAIVER: both fixtures (canonical b6c18f61…/13425, boundary c31fa423…/13627), filing-instructions page 5, and participant-instructions.md line 22 (FEE_AND_WAIVER row) print 'So: expect to be asked for $150, and ask the clerk's office of the Mississippi court that granted nonadjudication and entered the dismissal or closure order what that court charges for this petition before you go'. That publishes a figure to the participant as the amount to expect on a § 99-15-26(5) petition, which no held record supports: the profile's only $150 line is keyed to § 99-19-72 petitions under § 99-19-71 (A3: a line keyed to a different statute is a sibling inference), the packet itself says no bound record settles whether that fee reaches § 99-15-26(5), and owner decision Q4 (OWNER_BATCH_ADOPTION_2026-09-02, 'DO NOT PUBLISH AN UNCONFIRMED FEE … direct the participant to the specific clerk or agency for the current amount. Add a figure only when current primary authority or the official form supports it') forbids exactly this. The registry design for this remedy (legal-design-track-registry tracks[251] ms-nonadj) agrees: 'No amount is published here. Section 99-19-72's fee applies by its terms to petitions under § 99-19-71 and does not reach § 99-15-26. The participant confirms with the clerk.'

Smallest form: 'So: ask the clerk's office of ... what that court charges for this petition before you go'. Whether to keep quoting the profile's $150 § 99-19-71 line at all is a copy call (RV-02's accepted wording on the same profile publishes no figure).
